reviews.review: spent too much time on this, but top game if you want a realistic shooter

amazing warfare simulation. opposite end of the spectrum from Call of Duty. in the time it will take me to finish programming my peripherals (keyboard and mouse bindings, joystick, throttle and rudder pedal axis and vehicle combat commands) i could have finished most of the Call of Duty GAMES i got on sale and haven't even played yet (with Arma3 and Battlefield1 i probably never will play them).
Great campaign, steep learning curve and very realistic. GG

Wow, finally a worthy successor to Operation Flashpoint!
Played Operation Flashpoint and mods till i was having fashes from the game in my daily life as i looked to a hill, or driving and watching the rolling plains with bushes and trees early in the morning - it was so captivating, including AI, mechanics, graphics, everything.
Played Arma 1 and 2, they just coudn't hold me and i thought my appetite for such games was lost.
Arma 3 brought it all back while playing the campaign. Soon after a couple of missions i switched to veteran difficulty and I was back in the good old days of Operation Flashpoint fun, where you really appreciate no scripting in a game and the power and danger of every enemy soldier. Your squad mates might all get taken out in a mission, then after a reload, situation could be completely reversed, depending on who sighted who first, who was where, who hit, who missed, who decided to go prone, what orders were issued, what you did to help.
For new players, after you play for a while, you will notice subtle things that shine through, such as radio comms. You will notice that squad members may not report they brought someone down because target is far and they are unsure, so they will call 'clear' after a while only and no target movement. You will notice how 'man down' is only called if squad member went down in front of someone, or they don't report status when asked. You will understand how well the whole visibility of the situation actually works and how much all these radio comms actually help.
I could go on for a while, so i will just say Arma 3 is what Arma 1 should have been after OpFlashpoint.

Buy, invest time in it, play on veteran, which allows you only one save per mission and feel the realism and danger and how you care about your every move.
